name: Artichoke with pork hock
summary: Artichoke stewed with pork hock, named in the Da Lat set at one clay-pot rice door.
origin: Visit Lâm Đồng’s food-tour note says cơm niêu Việt Nam stands in for Da Lat cooking with atiso hầm giò heo, lẩu tả pín lù, and braised fish.
howToEat: Order it with the clay-pot rice. A recipe was not printed.
where: Cơm niêu Việt Nam, 3h Nam Kỳ Khởi Nghĩa, open 09:00–22:00.
priceBand: A price for this plate alone is Check on arrival. The door’s printed band is 30,000–380,000 VND.
